activity_summary: Gib is asleep on the cloth that is on the Holinshed. He has plainly been there since July. The title is covered. You did not shift him, and you did not take the book back.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not take the book back.

entities.name: Holinshed
entities.context: Mentioned in The cat on the cloth

facets.activity: Left the book under the cat
